post_call_analysis_data.name: call_summary
post_call_analysis_data.description: Two sentences: what kind of business they run and how the call ended. No names, emails or phone numbers.

post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: joined = save_lead succeeded with stage final (a name and an email are enough); callback = save_lead succeeded with stage callback; declined = they said no or left without giving an email; incomplete = anything else.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_requested
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the visitor explicitly asked to be contacted later.

post_call_analysis_data.name: objections
post_call_analysis_data.description: Objections they actually raised, short phrases separated by '; '. Empty if none.
